questions: Is the child unresponsive or difficult to awaken during these episodes?
Do the eyes repeatedly roll upward or deviate to one side during the episodes?
Does the mouth repeatedly open, and does the tongue protrude, during the episodes?
Do the episodes occur in clusters, with several episodes close together?
Do the episodes happen repeatedly every day?
Do they occur mainly when the child is waking up or falling asleep?
Do the episodes stop when you touch or hold the child?
Are there rhythmic jerking or stiffening movements of the arms or legs?
Has the child ever stopped breathing, turned blue, or become unusually pale during an episode?
Does the child return completely to normal after each episode?
Does the child currently have a fever?
Has the child recently had a serious illness, head injury, or fall?
Has the child ever had a seizure before?
Has anyone in the family had seizures during infancy or childhood?
Has the child been developing normally for age?
Has the child recently started any medication, traditional remedy, or potentially toxic substance?
Has the child had repeated vomiting, unusual sleepiness, or persistent irritability?
